data.name: Hunaydah
data.gender_notes: Hunaydah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-n-d, meaning 'grace, adornment'. In Islamic literature, Hunaydah is a female name associated with grace, elegance, and beauty. The name Hunaydah carries the meaning “Graceful, adorned with grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hunaydah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, adorned with grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hunaydah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, adorned with grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hunaydah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Hunaydah
in_english.meaning: Hunaydah refers to the wives of the Prophet Muhammad
in_english.long_meaning: Hunaydah refers to the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), who were from the tribe of Quraysh. All of them were free, independent women who were beloved by the Prophet (peace be upon him). Allah was pleased with all of them. They were all righteous, virtuous women who were devoted to Islam. They were all part of the Prophet's household, and each one had a unique role to play in the early Islamic community. Their names are a testament to the importance of women in Islamic society and the value placed on their virtues and contributions.
